# hl7-ig-corpus-example

> Worked example of the corpus-example pattern — multi-module
> documentation project that ingests a corpus of HL7 implementation
> guides into the IKE topic library and produces per-IG assemblies
> plus cross-IG analytic outputs.

## Documentation

- [hl7-ig-corpus-example](https://ike.network/hl7-ig-corpus-example/index.html.md)
